headline: Baron Capital Sees Years of Mid-Teens Growth for Intuitive Surgical (ISRG)
summary: Baron Capital, an investment management company, released its Q2 2026 investor letter for the “Baron Health Care Fund”. A copy of the letter is available to download here.
